budget_credibility.method: MHCLG Revenue Account budget (RA) vs Revenue Outturn (RO), GOV.UK. credibility_score = mean absolute total service-expenditure variance across available years; lower is more credible; bands <5 high, 5-10 moderate, >10 low. Ranked within tier only; district totals are volatile (small net base, gross benefit and one-off flows).
budget_credibility.data_source: MHCLG RA vs RO (GOV.UK), Open Government Licence v3.0

oversight.method: External referee verdicts per council from oversight.json: LGSCO complaint statistics, Ofsted ILACS and area SEND, CQC adult social care assessment, and PSAA audit-opinion delivery status. CQC ratings via the CASCAIDR compilation; audit status is a delivery-status proxy, not a literal opinion type. Judgments only, no generated prose.
oversight.data_source: LGSCO, Ofsted, CQC (via CASCAIDR), PSAA; registry overlay where verified
